concepts.label: Controlled project
concepts.definition: The disposable project named by the README's top-level heading; the subject whose receipt-service representation is declared.

concepts.label: Declared receipt-service representation
concepts.definition: The representation of the receipt service that the project's stated intent is to build.

concepts.label: Project scope
concepts.definition: The bounded scope of the controlled project: this disposable project only.

concepts.label: Existing Root qualification instruction
concepts.definition: The pre-existing instruction from Root that the README names as the project's frame; its content is not supplied in the source.

concepts.label: Public project provider
concepts.definition: The public provider named as the project's implementation route.

concepts.label: Current-host authored answers
concepts.definition: Answers authored by the current host, used with the public project provider.

concepts.label: Root's current owner-authorized STDO3.0.5 qualification
concepts.definition: The current qualification, authorized by its owner and issued by Root, that selects the disposable Product.

concepts.label: Selected disposable Product
concepts.definition: The single disposable Product that the qualification selects.

concepts.label: Operator
concepts.definition: The actor permitted to create the exact policies, inputs and evidence surfaces.

concepts.label: Exact policies, inputs and evidence surfaces
concepts.definition: The exact policies, inputs and evidence surfaces the operator may create.

grounding.quote: the exact policies, inputs and evidence

concepts.label: Named executive
concepts.definition: The executive, referred to as named but not named in this source, who may acquire, assemble, preflight and dispatch.

grounding.quote: The named executive may acquire, assemble, preflight and dispatch only

concepts.label: Registered local recipient
concepts.definition: The only recipient the named executive may act on; also the recipient whose writes are limited to outputs/.

concepts.label: Existing work grant
concepts.definition: The pre-existing work grant under which the named executive's operations are permitted; its content is not supplied.

concepts.label: outputs/ write territory
concepts.definition: The outputs/ location in this case, the only place the recipient may write.

grounding.quote: write only outputs/ in this case.

concepts.label: Ungranted effect classes
concepts.definition: Production work, Product adoption, global configuration, publication and Git effects, none of which is granted.

configuration, publication or Git effect is granted.

concepts.label: Negative variant
concepts.definition: A variant that removes the named issuer or recipient permission.

concepts.label: Named issuer permission
concepts.definition: The issuer permission a negative variant may remove.

grounding.quote: the named issuer or recipient permission

concepts.label: Named recipient permission
concepts.definition: The recipient permission a negative variant may remove.

grounding.quote: the named issuer or recipient permission

concepts.label: Resulting refusal
concepts.definition: The refusal that results when a negative variant removes the named issuer or recipient permission.

concepts.label: Process fixture
concepts.definition: The fixture process that receives the exact context and records only receipt bytes and one local counter.

grounding.quote: The process fixture receives the exact context

concepts.label: Exact context
concepts.definition: The exact context the process fixture receives.

concepts.label: Receipt bytes and one local counter
concepts.definition: The only things the process fixture records: receipt bytes and one local counter.

concepts.label: Process-end observation
concepts.definition: Observing that a process has ended or exited.

concepts.label: External descendants/effects
concepts.definition: Descendant processes and effects outside the observed process, whose state remains unknown at process end.

concepts.label: Bounded receipt service
concepts.definition: The service that records whether a requested delivery is admitted.

concepts.label: Requested delivery
concepts.definition: A delivery that has been requested; its admission is recorded by the service.

concepts.label: Admission outcome
concepts.definition: The recorded result of whether a requested delivery is admitted; line 4 supplies refusal as the outcome when a prerequisite fails.

grounding.quote: records whether a requested delivery is admitted

concepts.label: Issuer grant
concepts.definition: The issuer-side grant required for delivery.

concepts.label: Recipient grant
concepts.definition: The recipient-side grant required for delivery.

concepts.label: Current evidence
concepts.definition: Evidence that is current (not stale), required for delivery.

concepts.label: Completed process
concepts.definition: A process that has completed; by itself it does not establish settlement of external effects.

concepts.label: Settlement of all external effects
concepts.definition: The condition that all external effects have settled.

concepts.label: Uncertain prior effect
concepts.definition: An earlier effect whose outcome is uncertain.

concepts.label: Reconciliation
concepts.definition: Resolving an uncertain prior effect; required before a new attempt. The source does not define how.

concepts.label: New attempt
concepts.definition: A further attempt made after an uncertain prior effect.

concepts.label: Activation and history of the uncertain effect
concepts.definition: The activation and history of the uncertain prior effect, which must be kept.

concepts.label: Report
concepts.definition: The report whose wording may vary but which must preserve every prerequisite and unresolved item.

grounding.quote: The report may vary in wording

concepts.label: External host permission setting
concepts.definition: A permission setting of an external host, whose meaning and enforcement this source leaves unresolved.

residuals.uncertainty: The intent calls the representation 'declared' but does not say where it is declared or what form it takes. It is not explicitly linked to the RULES.md bounded receipt service.
residuals.consequence: Linking the intent's target to the RULES.md service is a reading, not a source statement. No acceptance criterion follows from the intent alone.

residuals.uncertainty: The source does not supply the content of the 'Existing Root qualification instruction'. It also does not say whether this is the same as the 'current owner-authorized STDO3.0.5 qualification' named in the grant section.
residuals.consequence: The project's frame is an unresolved external reference. Nothing that depends on its content can be derived from this source.

residuals.uncertainty: The source refers to 'the named executive', 'the registered local recipient' and 'the existing work grant', but names none of them and does not define registration.
residuals.consequence: Which actor may act, on which recipient and under which grant terms cannot be determined from this source alone. These must be resolved from external policy or activation data.

grounding.quote: the registered local recipient under the existing work grant.

residuals.uncertainty: The grant section's 'named issuer or recipient permission' may denote the same prerequisites as the 'issuer grant' and 'recipient grant' in RULES.md, and 'the named executive' may be the issuer. The source does not state either identity, so they are kept as separate local concepts.
residuals.consequence: The cross-document identity is unresolved. Without further source, it should not be assumed that the permission a negative variant removes is exactly the RULES.md grant.

residuals.uncertainty: 'Current' and 'stale' are undefined: there is no freshness criterion, clock or basis. Absent evidence, as opposed to stale evidence, is not listed as a refusal trigger.
residuals.consequence: Judging freshness, and the refusal outcome for missing evidence, depend on a definition outside this source. Line 3's prerequisite still withholds delivery when current evidence is not present.

residuals.uncertainty: The source says what does not establish settlement of external effects, but not what evidence would.
residuals.consequence: Unless separately evidenced, settlement of external effects remains unknown. It is neither true nor false.

residuals.uncertainty: The source does not define how reconciliation is performed or evidenced, or who may perform it.

dispositions.reason: The top-level heading names the controlled project; retained as the project concept. Line 2 is blank.
The intent is retained as a non-governing declares_intent relation. Where the 'declared' representation is declared is unresolved and kept as a residual.
The scope limit is retained as a concept and a constraint.
The frame reference is retained, but the instruction's content is not supplied and is kept as a residual.
The implementation route is retained as descriptive, non-governing relations.

Every grant clause, permission, territory, excluded effect, negative-variant rule, fixture bound and process-end rule is retained. The unnamed actors, the unsupplied grant and the cross-document issuer/recipient identity are kept as residuals.

All eight lines are retained: the admission record, the conjunctive prerequisites, refusal triggers, process completion versus settlement, reconcile-before-retry with history retention, and report wording latitude. The undefined freshness, settlement evidence and reconciliation procedure, and the host permission setting the source explicitly leaves unresolved, are kept as residuals.

limitations: The fixed author prompt asset says 'The selected published calculus basis is STDO 2.5.1-rc.2', but PROJECT_BINDING_JSON binds the method stdo://releases/v3.0.5/ (manifest 9304727d370ae58a0b955d1f831ee15e8dddeb2ca3e8886454233a8422846142). This interpretation uses the project binding as the method identity and records the discrepancy without resolving it.

Cross-section and cross-document identities are kept as separate local concepts and not merged: the Root instruction versus the owner-authorized qualification, the controlled project versus the selected disposable Product, and the named issuer/recipient permission versus the RULES.md issuer/recipient grants.

Source-described workflow (acquire, assemble, preflight, dispatch, reconciliation, refusal) is represented only as concepts and constraints. No judgment, traversal, transformation or operation is claimed or performed.
Product.json, AGENTS.md, ticketing surfaces and any policy/activation data are outside the declared-WHAT-only source scope (README.md and RULES.md) and are not interpreted here.
Grounded quotes prove source re-entry only. They do not prove that the authored statements are faithful or that the interpretation is semantically complete.
